purpose: Check one finite weight-only condition for task-outside numerical change before constructing a joint functional defense.
information: Only original target/public weights and fixed weight-derived32dimensional task singular subspaces. Original cleanAGA used after construction only to identify the old reference assignment. No real/generated image,classhead,partner,candidate or exposed counterexample.

basis.operation: QR reorthogonalize the same columns inFP64;no rank/direction selection

solution: Minimum Frobenius norm subject to these equalities: G=PL elementwise(A0PR A0^T),b=-diag(AA0^T),Glambda=b,deltaA=PLdiag(lambda)A0PR. One undamped Cholesky solve;failure stops,no rank/budget/ridge retry.
independent_check: NumPy QR and products,SciPy Cholesky;all equalities,KKT/norm identity andFP32actual matrix. Relative residual1e-8,FP32relative task-probe leakage5e-7,FP32maximum corresponding-row cosine1e-5. These check implementation,not natural function.
parameter_scope: No arbitrary distance cap or amplitude sweep. Report the unique minimum distance required by the fixed condition;not automatically historicalD0.5compliant. No publication model is constructed by this check.

author_matching.measure: All rows,assignment change versus original reference,aligned lastMLP A/a/B differences. Changed assignment/parameter distance is not classification harm.

finite_probes: All64positive/negative unit task right-singular vectors;original bias andB unchanged. Synthetic MLP-vector responses only,no images or full encoder.
limits: Task SVD is not an image-function zero space. This changes nonlinear neuron responses outside its probes and is not a global function-preserving permutation/scaling. Native function and anti-merging effect require jointB/multilayer compensation and actual separate evaluation. No novelty or security guarantee from the standard linear algebra.
no_retry: One original/public pair,one fixed layer/rank/condition;no angle,strength,row subset,seed or solver sweep.Closed19d/069e and previous affine controls are not loaded or repaired.
